summary: Full validation of the new /onboarding flow. Backend: 11/11 new onboarding tests pass (happy path, /auth/me with new credentials, dup email 409, 3x 422 validation, slug accents+collision, real-address geocoding to Madrid coords, bogus address null, explicit lat/lng wins). 17/17 prior tests (card_config + preview_pass) still pass — no regression. Frontend: /onboarding loads as a public route, all 6 steps work (text input gating, pill select, suggestion chip populates input, color swatch updates preview gradient in real time + shows check icon, dirección + locate button, email/pwd validation), chat history of prior Q+A is rendered, finishing the flow auto signs-in and lands on /dashboard with the new tenant brand in the sidebar; /login has 'Crear cuenta gratis' [data-testid=login-signup-link] that navigates to /onboarding; an authenticated session visiting /onboarding is redirected to /dashboard; no regressions on /dashboard, /configuracion-tarjeta, /preview-pass.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='onb-pass-preview' is rendered TWICE in the DOM (desktop right column + mobile-below copy). One is hidden via Tailwind 'hidden lg:block' wrapper, but the testid being on both inner cards triggers Playwright strict-mode violations. Suggest unique testids (onb-pass-preview-desktop / onb-pass-preview-mobile) or move the testid to the wrapper.

Pill data-testids do NOT strip accents — 'Cafetería' → 'onb-tipo-negocio-cafeter-a' (hyphen mid-word), 'Clínica' → 'onb-tipo-negocio-cl-nica', 'Peluquería' → 'onb-tipo-negocio-peluquer-a'. The backend slugifier strips them correctly. Recommend using the same accent-normalization in the testid generator at Onboarding.jsx L358 for consistency and discoverability.

After step 2 the preview's bottom-right ID slot displays the selected tipo_negocio in uppercase (e.g. 'RESTAURANTE') instead of an ID-style label. Minor cosmetic — visible in screenshot but matches the existing card layout, may be by design.

action_items: (Optional, LOW) Onboarding.jsx L358: normalize accents (á/é/í/ó/ú/ñ → a/e/i/o/u/n) before regex-replace so tipo_negocio testids match Spanish word stems (cafeteria, clinica, peluqueria).
(Optional, LOW) Disambiguate the two onb-pass-preview elements so Playwright / RTL queries don't hit strict-mode violations.
(Carry-over) server.py is now 1592 lines — still grow-worthy and would benefit from a split into routers (public, admin, super, public_onboarding).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L869-887: auth.create_user → on 'duplicate' substring match we return 409 with a Spanish message. Verified via real call; works. The substring match (any of 'already'/'registered'/'exists'/'duplicate') is broad but correct for Supabase wording today — flag if Supabase ever localizes its admin error strings.
server.py L894-896: caller-provided lat/lng correctly short-circuits the Nominatim call (verified: Barcelona coords (41.38, 2.17) won despite 'Calle Mayor, Madrid' direccion).

server.py L898-937: tenant insert → admin insert is wrapped in a single try block with auth user rollback. Note: if the *admin* insert fails AFTER the *tenant* insert succeeds, the tenant row is NOT rolled back — only the auth user. This leaves an orphan tenant with no admin user. Consider a second compensating delete on tenants[id] in that branch. (Hard to hit in practice but worth documenting.)
server.py _slugify L804: accent map only covers lowercased vowels + ñ; uppercase Ñ/Á etc. are normalized indirectly via .lower() first — verified by Café Niño Sí → cafe-nino-si. Good.
Onboarding.jsx onLocate: 8s geolocation timeout, error toast on failure, sets direccion to 'Ubicación detectada por GPS' if empty — solid UX.

Onboarding.jsx onFinish auto-signs-in via supabase.auth.signInWithPassword then navigates to /dashboard — fallback to /login with toast on failure. Verified happy path uses dashboard branch (sidebar shows new tenant name + email).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 steps, navigation, redirects, regression checks pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding endpoint: POST /api/public/onboarding (public, no auth). Required fields: nombre_marca (≥2), tipo_negocio, nombre_programa (≥2), color_primario (#xxxxxx), email, password (≥6). Optional: direccion, lat, lng. Returns {success, tenant_slug, tenant_id, redirect_url:'/dashboard'}. On success creates: (a) Supabase Auth user with email_confirm=true, (b) tenants row with plan='starter' (requires migration 2026_02_onboarding.sql), (c) usuarios_admin row with rol='admin'. Slug from _slugify(nombre_marca) normalized via accent map (á→a, ñ→n, etc) lowercased + hyphenated, max 48 chars; collision adds 2-byte hex suffix. Geocoding: Nominatim best-effort, fails silently to null. Frontend page /onboarding is the conversational UI; key testids: onb-progress, onb-prompt-{1..6}, onb-step-{1..6}, onb-nombre-marca, onb-tipo-negocio-{restaurante|gimnasio|tienda|otro|club-deportivo} (accented ones use weird mid-word hyphens — Cafetería → cafeter-a, Clínica → cl-nica, Peluquería → peluquer-a), onb-nombre-programa, onb-programa-suggest-club-de-socios, onb-color-presets, onb-color-{hex} (e.g. onb-color-ef4444), onb-color-picker, onb-color-hex, onb-direccion, onb-locate, onb-email, onb-password, onb-continue, onb-finish, onb-pass-preview (DUPLICATED — use .first), onb-preview-marca, onb-go-login. On Login page: login-signup-link → /onboarding. After finish, code does supabase.auth.signInWithPassword then navigate to /dashboard; fallback /login on signin failure.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Two minor frontend code-quality items: (1) duplicate data-testid='onb-pass-preview' (desktop+mobile copies both have the same testid) causing strict-mode locator violations — reproducible by `await page.locator('[data-testid=onb-pass-preview]').evaluate(...)` without .first; (2) testid generator for tipo_negocio pills doesn't normalize accents before regex-replace, producing odd mid-word hyphens for Spanish accented options (cafeter-a, cl-nica, peluquer-a). Both LOW priority — happy path and all assertions pass when using .first / unaccented options.
